dimension_notes_summary.cross_module_architecture: Clean unidirectional dependency flow from API routes and bot handlers to CRUD and database models.
dimension_notes_summary.high_level_elegance: Dual-interface architecture (Telegram Bot + Web MiniApp) sharing a single async SQLite/Postgres backend.
dimension_notes_summary.convention_outlier: Standard snake_case convention consistently adhered to across all backend modules and test files.
dimension_notes_summary.error_consistency: FastAPI routes consistently raise HTTPException with descriptive error messages and status codes.
dimension_notes_summary.naming_quality: Identifiers clearly reflect business domain: create_one_time_task, toggle_routine_completion, get_user_groceries.
dimension_notes_summary.abstraction_fitness: SQLAlchemy async ORM maps data storage cleanly without leaky abstractions.
dimension_notes_summary.dependency_health: Dependencies in requirements.txt are modern (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0, Aiogram 3.x, Pydantic 2.x).
dimension_notes_summary.low_level_elegance: Idiomatic Python 3 async/await constructs throughout all I/O bound modules.
dimension_notes_summary.mid_level_elegance: Single responsibility principle respected across individual CRUD functions.
dimension_notes_summary.test_strategy: Test suite includes 52 regression and stress tests for persistence, numeric tasks, and edge cases.
dimension_notes_summary.api_surface_coherence: Consistent RESTful resource endpoints under /api for tasks, routines, goals, and groceries.
dimension_notes_summary.authorization_consistency: Centralized get_current_user FastAPI dependency protects all private endpoints.
dimension_notes_summary.ai_generated_debt: No boilerplate hallucinations, commented-out placeholder blocks, or pseudo-code stubs.
dimension_notes_summary.incomplete_migration: All database queries use SQLAlchemy 2.0 select() style with AsyncSession.
dimension_notes_summary.package_organization: Logical package layout: backend/api for web endpoints, backend/bot for Telegram bot, backend/crud for storage.
dimension_notes_summary.initialization_coupling: Lazy initialization of Telegram Bot avoids startup failures when token is absent.
dimension_notes_summary.design_coherence: Cohesive architectural pattern: user commands trigger CRUD modifications which reflect in WebApp and bot.
dimension_notes_summary.contract_coherence: Pydantic models in schemas.py define strict contracts for frontend interactions.
dimension_notes_summary.logic_clarity: Task scheduling and streak calculation algorithms are clearly expressed and commented.
dimension_notes_summary.type_safety: Type hints applied across function signatures and return types in backend modules.
